patients: Find a patient or open '+ Yeni Hasta' in the Turkish UI to create a record. From the patient card, open their cases or scans, or choose 'Yeni Tarama' to start a scan.
cases: Find a case in the clinic or laboratory queue. Case details connect scans, design, messages, finance and delivery. In a clinic choose 'Yeni Vaka' in the Turkish UI and select a patient and a laboratory.
appointments: In the clinic calendar select a day and choose '+ Randevu Ekle' in the Turkish UI. Verify the patient, date and time before 'Randevuyu Kaydet'. Use 'Takvime indir' to export an existing appointment to a calendar file.
scans: Find saved scans and open a scan in Scan Studio. Review the linked patient and case before using a scan for design.
scan-studio: Inspect a scan model and associate it with the relevant patient or case. Confirm orientation, jaw and units before using the Turkish UI's 'Taramayı Kaydet ve CAD'e Aç' option for an eligible scan.
clinic: Use the clinic hub to open patients, cases, appointments and scan tools. Open the destination module to review its current records.
cad-library: Manage personal CAD forms. Open DentAYA Design to place a form into an active design.
labs: Find laboratory connections and review the intended laboratory before assigning a clinic case.
lab: Use the laboratory hub to reach the work queue and design tools. Open a case to review its handoff and current status.
training: Explore research scans and fictional case workflows. Demo records are for practice and evaluation.
logistics: Review a case shipment and its delivery status. Confirm package, address and tracking information before making changes.
operations: Review work status, capacity and bottlenecks. Use work tracking filters to identify overdue jobs and review their owners.
finance: Select a case to review its pricing and payment status. Available quote and collection controls depend on the organization role.
team: Review members, roles and invitations. Changing access requires the relevant organization permissions.
messages: Open the relevant conversation and check the intended recipients before sending. Case context can be attached to organization conversations.
notifications: Review incoming notices and their destinations. Open the relevant module to confirm the current state of the underlying item.
community: Browse professional discussions and articles. Check permissions and remove identifying patient information before sharing.
settings: Manage appearance, language, notifications and other preferences. Organization and account settings require the applicable account and role.
pilot-flow: Review pilot workflow records and verification evidence.
pilot-check: Review application and pilot readiness checks.
ops-health: Review operational status and events available to the current organization.
release-check: Review the installed product version and available release checks.
twin: Open a digital patient model and review its scan versions in the application. Confirm the intended version before handoff.
